compatibilityCandidate.title: Extension Save As may acquire an unrelated Profile's last-active native parent
compatibilityCandidate.observation: The picker permits EXTENSION_API without associated WebContents. If owning_window is absent or lacks a host, it uses GetLastActiveBrowserWindowInterfaceWithAnyProfile()->GetWindow()->GetNativeWindow(). DownloadPrefs still comes from the DownloadItem BrowserContext.
compatibilityCandidate.inference: An extension request originating in Profile A may be parented to the last-active Profile B host. Source alone does not prove actual UI misrouting or data access across Profiles.
